_comment: Admission policy for upstream pull requests, applied by
.github/scripts/scan_pr.py before the auto-merge touches a branch.
Verdicts: 'ok' merges; 'review' and 'block' keep the PR out of main and
appear in the run summary. The policy is read from the trusted base ref,
so a pull request cannot loosen the rules that judge it.

review_thresholds._comment: Historic upstream PRs: median 2 files / 95 lines, p90 8 / 396, largest 74 / 2123.

blocked_paths..github/: CI, the gate scripts and the publish pipeline
blocked_paths.Makefile: runs arbitrary commands in CI and in the publish job
blocked_paths.setup.py: build backend: executes with publish credentials
blocked_paths.MANIFEST.in: changes what the published sdist contains
blocked_paths..gitmodules: fetches code from another repository at CI time
blocked_paths..gitattributes: filter and diff drivers can execute commands
blocked_paths.sitecustomize.py: imported automatically by every Python interpreter
blocked_paths.usercustomize.py: imported automatically by every Python interpreter

review_paths.pyproject.toml: dependencies and packaging metadata; the build backend is blocked separately
review_paths.conftest.py: pytest collection hook: runs in CI and can neutralise the tests
review_paths.*/conftest.py: pytest collection hook: runs in CI and can neutralise the tests

blocked_lines.reason: changes the build backend, which runs with publish credentials
installs from a git source instead of the package index
installs a downloaded archive instead of a resolved dependency
